independentAudit.completeScope: Exact nominal chain interval plus every explicitly recorded selected signature; not proof of receive-window completeness

applicationAvailabilityTarget.timeBasis: fully validated application availability; never chain or feed time

chainAuditTarget.timeBasis: on-chain blockTime seconds; separate from the application window

applicationTargetReadiness.explanation: Independent blockTime coverage audits a separate chain interval. Original validated receive times remain explicit, including events before/after this target; later audit data never enters the original feature window.
